title: General chart of Hudson Strait showing the three expedition bases
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Foldout chart (Appendix 2) of the whole strait from Resolution Island to Nottingham Island, with the positions of Bases A, B and C marked.

title: Vicinity chart of Station A: Resolution Island, Port Burwell and Cape Chidley
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Foldout chart (Appendix 3) of the eastern entrance to Hudson Strait around Base A at Port Burwell, plotting the triangular routine air patrols A-I, A-II and A-III flown from the base.

title: Vicinity chart of Station C headquarters at Wakeham Bay
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Foldout chart (Appendix 4) of the Wakeham Bay area around Base C, plotting routine air patrols C-I and C-IV and the Charles Island direction-finding site.

title: Vicinity chart of Station B at Nottingham Island
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Foldout chart (Appendix 5) of Nottingham Island, Salisbury Island and Fox Channel around Base B, plotting routine air patrols B-II, B-III and B-IV.

title: Chart indicating the special ice-reconnaissance patrols flown across Hudson Strait, 1927-28
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Foldout chart (Appendix 6) of the full strait marking the long special patrols flown from all three bases beyond the routine triangles, used to track ice at the height of the season.

title: Mean monthly air temperatures and condensed ice record at Bases A, B and C
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: A printed table giving mean monthly air temperature by base for 1927-28 alongside a condensed ice record: the date ice first formed, its maximum thickness, and the date the strait ran clear at each of the three bases.

title: Table of differences between the Admiralty chart and Mr. Madill's astronomical observations
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: A table comparing charted positions against the fixes taken by magnetician R. G. Madill at Port Burwell, Resolution Island, Cape Hopes Advance, Wakeham Bay and Nottingham Island, showing the existing charts to be inaccurate by several nautical miles at some points.

title: Meteorological log of the C.G.S. Stanley, Halifax to Hudson Strait and return, 1927
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: A table (Appendix 7) recording barometer, wind, weather and the ship's position twice or three times daily on the Stanley's outward passage from Halifax through the Strait of Belle Isle to Hudson Strait.

title: Meteorological log of the C.G.S. Montcalm, Quebec to Hudson Strait and return, 1928
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: A table (Appendix 8) recording barometer, wind, weather and position for the Montcalm's 1928 voyage north, including her passage along the Labrador coast and first encounters with ice off Akpatok Island.

title: Monthly meteorological observations at Base A, October and November 1927
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: A table (Appendix 10) of daily air temperature, wind, barometer and fresh- and salt-water ice thickness recorded at Base A, Port Burwell, through the autumn freeze-up of 1927.

title: Water temperatures taken from the C.G.S. Montcalm on the 1928 voyage to Hudson Strait
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: A table (Appendix 11) of sea-surface temperatures by date, time and place along the Montcalm's 1928 track from Anticosti Island through the strait to Wakeham Bay and Port Burwell.

title: Base B, Nottingham Island: power house, camp, storehouse and hangar
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Two photographs of Base B on Nottingham Island soon after construction, showing the power house, camp tents, storehouse, temporary shack, earth-banked hangar and men's dwelling laid out along the shore.

title: Base B: erecting buildings and unloading an aircraft fuselage case
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Two photographs of construction work at Base B, Nottingham Island: a work crew framing a building on the bedrock, and men unloading a large crated aircraft fuselage from a scow.

title: Base B: an aircraft fuselage case handled by tractor and derrick
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Two photographs showing a crated Fokker fuselage being hauled up an elevator by tractor, and then lifted by a wooden derrick, during the landing of aircraft at Base B, Nottingham Island.

title: Base B: erecting a derrick on bare rock, and lumber being unloaded in the harbour
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Two photographs of Base B construction: a tall timber derrick being raised directly on bedrock with block and tackle, and boat loads of lumber being landed in the harbour.

title: The ss. Larch alongside, swinging cargo and coaling the ship at Nottingham Island
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Two photographs of the chartered freighter ss. Larch: a launch swinging in to shore with a fuselage case under tow, and the Larch at anchor while coal is pumped from her for the base.

title: Base B completed: temporary shack, dwellings, storehouse and power house
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Two photographs of the finished Base B station on Nottingham Island, a scattering of small frame buildings on bare, boulder-strewn ground with a radio mast and horizon hut.

title: Base C, Wakeham Bay: the station buildings and the Hudson's Bay Company post
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Two photographs of Base C at Wakeham Bay: the storehouse, men's dwelling and other buildings on the flat above the anchorage, with the Hudson's Bay Company's trading post visible nearby.

title: Base A, Port Burwell: Mission Cove, the Hudson's Bay Company post and R.C.M.P. quarters
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Two photographs of Mission Cove at Port Burwell, Base A, showing the Hudson's Bay Company's cove and post and the Royal Canadian Mounted Police quarters from different vantage points.

title: An aircraft wireless receiving set and its operator at Base C
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Two photographs: a general view of the camp site at Base C from a nearby hill, and a wireless operator seated at an aircraft radio receiving set inside one of the station buildings.

title: A Fokker floatplane winched from its hangar and launched for the first flight of 1928
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Two photographs of expedition aircraft "BF": being winched out of its hangar on a tractor-drawn cradle, and afloat on its pontoons after launching for the first flight of the 1928 season.

title: A floatplane at the entrance to Wakeham Bay, and an Inuit family's tent
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Two photographs: expedition aircraft "BE" on the water at the entrance to Wakeham Bay, and an Inuit tent with a family standing beside it near Base C.

title: Inuit at Wakeham Bay: a group portrait, and snow shelters
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Two photographs taken near Base C: a group portrait of about a dozen Inuit men, women and children in fur parkas, and a row of snow shelters with several people at work outside them.

title: Robert Anakotok, an Inuk at Base C, and the radio hut at low tide
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Two photographs: the hangar and radio cache at Base C seen at low tide, and a portrait of "Native Robert Anakotok," one of the very few Inuit individuals named anywhere in the expedition's printed report.

title: Expedition airmen beside aircraft "HH," and aircraft on the ice during the search for a missing plane
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Two photographs: a group of flying officers standing under the wing of aircraft G-CAHH, and expedition aircraft drawn up on sea ice during the search mounted for a missing crew.

title: An aircraft anchored on the ice, and the wireless room at Base C
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Two photographs: an expedition floatplane anchored on sea ice, and the wireless room at Base C, Wakeham Bay, showing its full radio panel with the operator seated at the key.

title: The power house at Base C, and an aerial photograph of broken ice off Nottingham Island
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Two photographs: the small power house of Base C, Wakeham Bay, with its masts, and an aerial reconnaissance photograph of pack ice fifteen miles southeast of Nottingham Island taken from about 1,000 feet.

title: Aerial ice-reconnaissance photographs near Nottingham Island
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Two air-to-ground photographs of broken pack ice near Nottingham Island, taken from about 1,000 feet during routine ice patrols in the spring of 1928.

title: Base B seen from the air, and aircraft G-CAHG in flight
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Two aerial photographs: the hangar site of Base B, Nottingham Island, seen from about 1,000 feet, and expedition aircraft G-CAHG photographed in flight from a second aircraft.

title: Ice off Digges Island with an aircraft visible, and four named men at an igloo near Base C
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Two photographs: pack ice forty miles north of Digges Island with expedition aircraft "BE" a speck in the upper corner, and four men, Nutarak, Moses Koorkoolik, Lewis and Jamieson, standing by a snow igloo near Base C, Wakeham Bay.

title: Ice conditions in front of the hangars, and an aerial view of Wakeham Bay
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Two photographs: heavy ice crowding the shore in front of the hangars at Base C in mid-June 1928, and an aerial view of Wakeham Bay in January 1928 with the Hudson's Bay Company post visible.

title: An iceberg and men standing on the sea ice near Nottingham Island
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Two photographs of ice conditions off Nottingham Island: a large iceberg drifting in open water, and three men standing out on a flat ice pan during a ground ice survey.

title: Heavy pack ice off Cape Hopes Advance and mid-strait off Wakeham Bay
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Two photographs of heavy, closely packed ice in July 1928: one taken abeam Cape Hopes Advance, the other in mid-strait off Wakeham Bay with broken floes in the foreground giving a sense of their thickness.

title: The direction-finding radio station at Cape Hopes Advance
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: The completed radio power house at the direction-finding station established at Cape Hopes Advance in 1928, with its D.F. mast and shortwave mast against the open shoreline.
